rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for drawing something physically toward you or drawing someone's attention, interest, or desire.

example.english: This series can attract many viewers.
example.traditional: 呢套劇集可以吸引好多觀眾。
example.jyutping: nei1 tou3 kek6 zaap6 ho2 ji5 kap1 jan5 hou2 do1 gun1 zung3
